blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — The Philippines’ Gabrielle Galapia is just a step away from the Miss Asia Pacific International 2026 crown now that she has gained a spot among the five finalists. What started as a field of 38 aspirants at the Mactan Expo in Lapu-Lapu City has now been further trimmed to just five delegates who will fight in the final round of the competition. Joining Galapia in the Final Five are South Africa’s Nompumelelo Malindi, Mexico’s Itzel Idolina Silva Borbon, Thailand’s Sasiwararin Atsawahirankarn, and Costa Rica’s Gia Angelique Franceschi.
